title: Blind by Design: Computational Supplement
description: Computational supplement to 'Blind by Design: Quantum Error Correction, Functional Incompatibility and the Value of Evidence' (Lex et Ratio Working Paper LXR-2026-PHI-BBDQEC-WP). Four scripts: a three-qubit repetition-code instrument showing observation-relative and function-relative blindness; an independent numerical check of a toric-code sign-symmetry result (Özgüler 2026, Proposition 1); a construction audit of Stim/PyMatching surface-code simulations; and a continuous error-correction simulation in which a misspecified detector efficiency is detected and repaired from the records already held. Includes the complete output of each reference run and the reliance note on the preprint result used in the paper.
